description: Datestamped, checksummed snapshots archived to the permaweb (Arweave via Permavault) for reproducibility and resilience. Public-domain or clearly-redistributable data only, since permaweb copies are public and permanent. Each entry lets any past Allelio result be reproduced against the exact reference data it used.

snapshots.note: Consumer-array frequency extract that the tool ships and loads; see data/gnomad_manifest.json.

variant_summary.txt.gz. Weekly rolling release; this is an insurance/reproducibility snapshot, NOT loaded by the tool (which fetches ClinVar live). Fill arweave_tx and arweave_url after the Permavault upload.
